title: One-factor repeated-measures ANOVA with a Greenhouse-Geisser sphericity rule
source_relation: adapted: fixed epsilon rule, function-style contract, covariance-formula oracle
difficulty_hypothesis: Agents either treat repeated measurements as independent, rely on ez/afex (not installed) for the sphericity correction, apply the correction to the F statistic or only to one df, mix up Greenhouse-Geisser with Huynh-Feldt, or fail to drop subjects with a missing occasion.

mcp_relevance.rationale: The statistics are specified in the prompt; the only ecosystem fact is that the usual convenience packages (ez, afex, rstatix) are not installed, which the supplied lockfile shows directly.
mcp_relevance.information_need: Box's epsilon formula and the aov Error() decomposition for within-subject designs.
mcp_relevance.obtainable_without_mcp: yes: stats::aov help and textbook formulas
alternative_solution_paths: aov with Error(subject/time) plus epsilon from the double-centred covariance eigenvalues
subjects-by-occasions matrix with closed-form sums of squares
nlme::gls/lme with an unstructured covariance is NOT equivalent and does not satisfy the contract

calibration_risks.ceiling: low-moderate: epsilon computation is a known stumbling block
calibration_risks.floor: moderate: several exact numbers must all be right

pinned_evidence.oracle: subjects-by-occasions sums of squares and Box's epsilon; cross-checked at load against aov(Error()) and the eigenvalue form of epsilon
